fact_text: On 31 May 2024 the KSE-100 was falling and traded below 75,000 points, in a downward trend.

fact_text: The analyst expected budget-related taxation to hit listed companies, sectors and banks, and possibly the index, and said the market would take a clearer view once the budget is set.
